decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already fully records the 3.4V DCDC1 source and Schottky-drop compensation in this Requirement; no additional or corrected Event is needed.
A same-message MODIFY already updates the incoming power role to describe the 3.4V DCDC1 output and resulting 3.3V system rail; the connector interface needs no further change.
Changing the upstream DCDC1 programmed voltage does not alter the monitor device, monitored rails, monitor position, or measurement coverage.
The panel power-button requirement is established by the separate first clause of the message; the DCDC1 voltage decision does not change its connector or control behavior.
The DCDC1 3.4V setting and main-board 3.3V OR-ing compensation do not change the independently controlled 5V boost rail.
AXP2101 remains the normal-operation power source with the same battery range and load coverage; the detailed DCDC1 output setting belongs to the source Requirement.
The DCDC1 rail-voltage decision does not change the charge-status display, LED connector, signal, resistance, or population requirements.
The programmed DCDC1 output does not alter the battery protection controller, cutoff voltages, or DW01A protection details.
The DCDC1 output-voltage adjustment does not affect the battery NTC terminal, connector, thermal function, or controller.
The source decision concerns DCDC1 rail regulation and does not resolve or modify the battery connector family, pin count, pin functions, part number, or pin-order ambiguity.
The compensated upstream supply still presents the same 3.3V and 5V rails to the sensor-board connectors, so the fanout inventory and pinouts remain unchanged.
These main-board panel controls and GPIO assignments are independent of the power-board DCDC1 output setting and the separate J_PWR_BTN requirement.
